def parse_demo(text,n):
    pat=rf'Demo pair {n} input \([^)]*\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair {n} output \([^)]*\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance\.|\Z)'
    m=re.search(pat,text,re.S)
    if not m: raise ValueError(f'no demo {n}')
    parse=lambda block:[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in block.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    return parse(m.group(1)),parse(m.group(2))
